abi.yml.definition:
name: ABI Compatibility

# Compares the candidate C shared library with its baseline using
# libabigail's abidiff; see docs/development/abi-compatibility.md. Before 1.0.0
# an incompatible change is reported but does not fail the job.
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: abi-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  abi:
    name: ABI Compatibility
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          # Tags are needed to tell whether the version is before 1.0.0.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install libabigail
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y abigail-tools ninja-build

      - name: Check the ABI against the baseline
        run: python3 scripts/abi/check.py --output-dir build/abi/report

      - name: Upload the ABI report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: abi-report-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/abi/report/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      # Full verification always includes the ABI-checker mutation self-tests.
      - name: Self-test the ABI check
        run: python3 scripts/abi/test_check.py

build-clang.yml.definition:
name: Clang Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

# PR CI runs Debug unit/integration tests. Full adds coverage, examples,
# Release and C-only configurations. Benchmarks remain advisory.
concurrency:
  group: clang-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  clang:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: Clang 18 / x64 / ${{ matrix.build_type }} / C++${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        build_type: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.full && '["Debug", "Release"]' || '["Debug"]') }}
        cxx_standard: [23]
    env:
      CC: clang-18
      CXX: clang++-18
      # Coverage and examples stay off the pull request path.
      COVERAGE: ${{ inputs.full && matrix.build_type == 'Debug' }}
      EXAMPLES: ${{ inputs.full }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install Clang
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 ninja-build

      - name: Set up ccache
        uses: hendrikmuhs/ccache-action@v1.2
        with:
          key: clang-18-${{ matrix.build_type }}-${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}

      - name: Install coverage tools
        if: env.COVERAGE == 'true'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y llvm-18 python3-venv
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-venv/bin/pip" install gcovr==8.4
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-18 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-18
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }}
          -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD=99 -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=${{ env.EXAMPLES == 'true' && 'ON' || 'OFF' }}
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache
          ${{ env.COVERAGE == 'true' && '-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=--coverage -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=--coverage -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=--coverage -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS=--coverage' || '' }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --parallel

      - name: Reset coverage counters before unit and integration tests
        if: env.COVERAGE == 'true'
        # GoogleTest discovery can execute instrumented binaries during the build.
        run: find build -type f -name '*.gcda' -delete

      - name: Run unit and integration tests
        run: |
          ctest --test-dir build -L unit --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
          ctest --test-dir build -L integration --output-on-failure --no-tests=error

      - name: Generate unit and integration test coverage report
        if: env.COVERAGE == 'true'
        # Collect before examples run and search only the main build tree.
        run: |
          test -n "$(find build -type f -name '*.gcno' -print -quit)" || { echo '::error::Missing coverage instrumentation data'; exit 1; }
          for group in unit integration; do
            test -n "$(find "build/tests/$group" -type f -name '*.gcda' -print -quit)" || { echo "::error::Missing $group coverage execution data"; exit 1; }
          done
          mkdir -p coverage
          gcovr build --root . \
            --gcov-executable 'llvm-cov-18 gcov' \
            --filter 'tlv/(src|include)/.*\.(c|h)$' \
            --filter 'tlv\+\+/include/.*\.(h|hpp)$' \
            --include 'tlv/(src|include)/.*\.(c|h)$' \
            --include 'tlv\+\+/include/.*\.(h|hpp)$' \
            --html-details coverage/index.html \
            --json-summary coverage/summary.json \
            --print-summary

      - name: Upload coverage report
        id: coverage-artifact
        if: env.COVERAGE == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-clang-debug-unit-integration-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: coverage/
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Summarize coverage
        if: env.COVERAGE == 'true'
        env:
          COVERAGE_ARTIFACT_URL: ${{ steps.coverage-artifact.outputs.artifact-url }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/summarize_coverage.py

      - name: Run the C quick-start embedded in the documentation
        if: env.EXAMPLES == 'true'
        run: |
          ./build/examples/tlv/example-tlv-quick-start
          # The C++ examples and other C examples are exercised
          # by the "ctest -L integration" step above instead.

  c-only:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: Clang 18 / C-only / ${{ matrix.build_type }}
    if: inputs.full
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        build_type: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.full && '["Debug", "Release"]' || '["Debug"]') }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install Clang
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 ninja-build

      - name: Verify C-only build
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build-c -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-18 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }} -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD=99 -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF -DOPENTLV_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON
          cmake --build build-c --parallel
          ./build-c/examples/tlv/example-tlv-quick-start
          ./build-c/examples/tlv/example-tlv-sequential-io
          ./build-c/examples/tlv/example-tlv-copies
          ./build-c/examples/tlv/example-tlv-schema-visitor
          ./build-c/examples/tlv/example-tlv-codecs-and-endian
          ./build-c/examples/tlv/example-tlv-custom-format
          ./build-c/examples/tlv/example-tlv-builtins-asn1-ber
          ./build-c/examples/tlv/example-tlv-builtins-asn1-cer

build-gcc.yml.definition:
name: GCC Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

jobs:
  gcc:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: GCC / x64 / ${{ matrix.build_type }} / C++${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - build_type: Debug
            cxx_standard: 11
          - build_type: Release
            cxx_standard: 23

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install Ninja
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ninja-build

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }}
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --parallel

      - name: Run unit and integration tests
        run: |
          ctest --test-dir build -L unit --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
          ctest --test-dir build -L integration --output-on-failure --no-tests=error

build-msvc.yml.definition:
name: MSVC Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

jobs:
  msvc-x86:
    if: inputs.full
    name: MSVC / x86 / ${{ matrix.build_type }} / C++${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.full && '[{"build_type":"Debug","cxx_standard":11},{"build_type":"Release","cxx_standard":23}]' || '[{"build_type":"Debug","cxx_standard":11}]') }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: windows-2022

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A Win32
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_UNIT_TESTS=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_INTEGRATION_TESTS=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config ${{ matrix.build_type }} --parallel

      - name: Run unit and integration tests
        run: ctest --test-dir build -C ${{ matrix.build_type }} --output-on-failure --no-tests=error

  msvc:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: MSVC / x64 / ${{ matrix.build_type }} / C++${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.full && '[{"build_type":"Debug","cxx_standard":11},{"build_type":"Release","cxx_standard":23}]' || '[{"build_type":"Debug","cxx_standard":11}]') }}

    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Initialize MSVC x64 environment
        uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1
        with:
          arch: x64

      - name: Verify Ninja availability
        run: ninja --version

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=cl -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=cl
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }}
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=${{ matrix.cxx_standard }}
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --parallel

      - name: Run unit and integration tests
        run: |
          ctest --test-dir build -L unit --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
          ctest --test-dir build -L integration --output-on-failure --no-tests=error

capabilities.yml.definition:
name: Capability profiles
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

jobs:
  capabilities:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        linkage: [shared, static]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Configure, link and run capability contracts
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.linkage }}" = static ]; then
            python3 scripts/check_capabilities.py --generator Ninja --static --cmake-arg=-DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=ON
          else
            python3 scripts/check_capabilities.py --generator Ninja --cmake-arg=-DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=ON
          fi

cmake-consumers.yml.definition:
name: Public CMake consumers

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  consumers:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.full && '["ubuntu-latest", "windows-2022"]' || '["ubuntu-latest"]') }}
        shared: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.full && '["ON", "OFF"]' || '["ON"]') }}
        cxx: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.full && '["ON", "OFF"]' || '["ON"]') }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Build and run external consumers
        run: >-
          python scripts/check_cmake_integration.py
          --shared ${{ matrix.shared }} --cxx ${{ matrix.cxx }}

codeql.yml.definition:
name: CodeQL

# Required by the repository's code-scanning rules. Both tiers call this worker
# without path filters and preserve the existing analysis category.
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: CodeQL / C++
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    env:
      CC: clang-18
      CXX: clang++-18
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install Clang and Ninja
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 ninja-build

      # A real build is required so CodeQL can trace the exact compiler
      # invocations; unlike the cppcheck/clang-tidy jobs in static-analysis.yml
      # this can't stop at `cmake` configure. Mirrors build-clang.yml's
      # Debug/C++23 configuration, minus the coverage, fuzzing and example-run
      # steps, which don't add anything to the CodeQL database.
      - name: Configure CMake
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-18 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-18
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
          -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD=99 -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=23 -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=${{ inputs.full && 'ON' || 'OFF' }}

      # Fetched GoogleTest is third-party code: compile it before CodeQL starts
      # tracing so its sources stay out of the database. First-party tests stay
      # traced, because they are the only C++ translation units in PR CI that
      # analyze the header-only tlv++ layer. See docs/development/quality-gates.md.
      - name: Build third-party test dependencies outside CodeQL
        run: cmake --build build --parallel --target gtest gtest_main gmock gmock_main

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: cpp
          # PR CI uses the default suite; Full uses security-extended.
          queries: ${{ inputs.full && 'security-extended' || '' }}

      - name: Build
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cmake --build build --parallel --verbose | tee build/codeql-build.log
          if grep -E -- ' -c [^ ]*/_deps/' build/codeql-build.log; then
            echo '::error::CodeQL traced a fetched third-party source'
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Perform CodeQL analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
        with:
          category: /language:cpp

core-checks.yml.definition:
name: Core checks

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        required: true
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  clang:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build-clang.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  msvc:
    if: inputs.full
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build-msvc.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  static:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/static-analysis.yml
    with:
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  consumers:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/cmake-consumers.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  codeql:
    # Required before merging to main; also retained in the complete Full tier.
    uses: ./.github/workflows/codeql.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  gcc:
    if: inputs.full
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build-gcc.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  properties:
    if: inputs.full
    uses: ./.github/workflows/property.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  query:
    if: inputs.full
    uses: ./.github/workflows/query-hardening.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  fuzz:
    if: inputs.full
    uses: ./.github/workflows/fuzz.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  capabilities:
    if: inputs.full
    uses: ./.github/workflows/capabilities.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  abi:
    if: inputs.full
    uses: ./.github/workflows/abi.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  memcheck:
    if: inputs.full
    uses: ./.github/workflows/valgrind.yml
    with:
      full: ${{ inputs.full }}
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}

  gate:
    name: Core quality gate
    if: always()
    needs: [clang, msvc, static, consumers, codeql, gcc, properties, query, fuzz, capabilities, abi, memcheck]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Require every selected check and record exact revision
        env:
          CHECK_RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          FULL: ${{ inputs.full }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py gate --output build/core-quality.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-quality-${{ inputs.full && 'full' || 'pr' }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/core-quality.json
          if-no-files-found: error

  timings:
    name: Core CI timings
    needs: gate
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Measure this attempt after checks finish
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python -B scripts/ci_timings.py --output build/ci-timings.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-timings-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/ci-timings.json
          if-no-files-found: error

core-full.yml.definition:
name: Core Full CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read
  security-events: write

concurrency:
  group: core-full-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  checks:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/core-checks.yml
    with:
      full: true
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.release_tag || '' }}

core-release.yml.definition:
name: Core Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: Release tag (v0.1.0 or v0.1.0-rc.1); changelog must be closed
        required: true
        type: string

env:
  RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: core-release-${{ inputs.tag }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  candidate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Validate version, closed changelog, main ancestry and Query prerequisites
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py preflight --output build/release-candidate.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-candidate-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/release-candidate.json
          if-no-files-found: error

  full:
    needs: candidate
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/core-full.yml
    with:
      release_tag: ${{ inputs.tag }}

  performance:
    needs: [candidate, full]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-candidate-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/candidate
      - name: Install release performance tools
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 clang-tools-18 ninja-build valgrind
      - name: Compare identical workloads against the locked stable release
        run: >-
          python -B scripts/core_performance.py run
          --candidate-record build/candidate/release-candidate.json
          --output build/release-performance --cc clang-18 --cxx clang++-18 --jobs 2
      - name: Publish advisory performance comparison
        run: cat build/release-performance/performance.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-path: |
            build/release-performance/performance.json
            build/release-performance/performance.md
            build/release-performance/performance-data.tar.gz
          create-storage-record: false
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-performance-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            build/release-performance/performance.json
            build/release-performance/performance.md
            build/release-performance/performance-data.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error

  source:
    needs: full
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Assemble exact source revision
        run: |
          python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare
          python -B scripts/core_release.py source --output build/release-source
      - name: Build extracted source without Git metadata
        run: |
          RELEASE_VERSION="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-source"
          tar -xzf build/release-source/*.tar.gz -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-source"
          source_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/core-source/OpenTLV-$RELEASE_VERSION"
          cmake -S "$source_dir" -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/source-build" -G Ninja \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
            -DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON
          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/source-build" --parallel 2
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/source-build/examples/tlv/example-tlv-quick-start"
      - uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-path: build/release-source/*
          create-storage-record: false
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-source-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/release-source/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  binaries:
    needs: full
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            id: linux-x64-static
            shared: 'OFF'
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            id: linux-x64-shared
            shared: 'ON'
          - os: windows-2022
            id: windows-x64-static
            shared: 'OFF'
          - os: windows-2022
            id: windows-x64-shared
            shared: 'ON'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare
      - uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        with:
          arch: x64
      - name: Configure approved Release binary
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build/release -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=11
          -DCMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreadedDLL
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=${{ matrix.shared }}
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_PROPERTY_TESTS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF
      - run: cmake --build build/release --parallel 2
      - name: Test the libraries that will be packaged
        run: ctest --test-dir build/release --output-on-failure --no-tests=error --parallel 2
      - name: Verify installation, archive contents and relocated consumers
        run: python -B scripts/check_package.py build/release
      - name: Record binary configuration and checksum
        run: >-
          python -B scripts/core_release.py binary --build build/release
          --id ${{ matrix.id }} --output build/release-binary
      - uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-path: build/release-binary/*
          create-storage-record: false
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-${{ matrix.id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/release-binary/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    needs: [candidate, full, performance, source, binaries]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: release-*-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/downloads
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-quality-full-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/quality
      - name: Collect only the approved artifact set
        env:
          ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/publish
          cp "build/downloads/release-source-$ATTEMPT/"* build/publish/
          for id in linux-x64-static linux-x64-shared windows-x64-static windows-x64-shared; do
            cp "build/downloads/release-$id-$ATTEMPT/"* build/publish/
          done
          cp "build/downloads/release-performance-$ATTEMPT/"* build/publish/
      - name: Recheck locked candidate and bind artifacts to Full CI and performance evidence
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: |
          python -B scripts/core_release.py preflight \
            --locked-candidate "build/downloads/release-candidate-$ATTEMPT/release-candidate.json" \
            --output build/quality/release-candidate.json
          python -B scripts/core_release.py manifest --output build/publish --quality build/quality/core-quality.json
      - name: Attest release manifest and checksums
        uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-path: |
            build/publish/release-manifest.json
            build/publish/SHA256SUMS
          create-storage-record: false
      - name: Verify producer attestations before publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          for artifact in build/publish/*; do
            gh attestation verify "$artifact" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --signer-workflow "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/.github/workflows/core-release.yml" \
              --source-digest "$RELEASE_SHA"
          done
      - name: Publish once, without replacing existing release assets
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          git push origin "$GITHUB_SHA:refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG"
          flags=()
          if [[ "$RELEASE_TAG" == *-* ]]; then flags+=(--prerelease); fi
          gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" build/publish/* --verify-tag \
            --title "OpenTLV $RELEASE_TAG" --generate-notes "${flags[@]}"

  timings:
    name: Release CI timings
    if: always()
    needs: [candidate, full, performance, source, binaries, publish]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Measure the complete release attempt
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python -B scripts/ci_timings.py --scope run --output build/ci-timings.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-release-timings-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/ci-timings.json
          if-no-files-found: error

fuzz.yml.definition:
name: C API Fuzzing

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fuzz:
    name: Clang 18 / C API fuzzing
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install Clang and sanitizer runtimes
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 libclang-rt-18-dev llvm-18 ninja-build

      # Restores libFuzzer-discovered inputs from the most recent previous run (falling back
      # to just the checked-in seed corpus on a cache miss), so each run's 60s fuzzing budget
      # builds on prior coverage instead of rediscovering it from scratch. The run_id-suffixed
      # key means every run saves a new cache entry (via restore-keys' prefix match on the next
      # run); GitHub evicts the oldest ones once the repo's cache quota fills up.
      - name: Restore fuzz corpus cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: build/fuzz/corpus
          key: fuzz-corpus-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: |
            fuzz-corpus-

      - name: Configure C API fuzzing
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build/fuzz -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-18 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
          -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD=99 -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_FUZZING=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
      - name: Build C API fuzz targets
        run: cmake --build build/fuzz --parallel
      - name: Fuzz each target for 60 seconds
        timeout-minutes: 20
        env:
          ASAN_OPTIONS: abort_on_error=1:detect_leaks=1
          UBSAN_OPTIONS: halt_on_error=1:abort_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          status=0
          mkdir -p build/fuzz/findings
          declare -A corpus_dir=(
            [read]=tests/fuzz/reader/corpus/read
            [visitor]=tests/fuzz/reader/corpus/visitor
            [roundtrip]=tests/fuzz/corpus/roundtrip
            [utf8]=tests/fuzz/corpus/utf8
            [fixed]=tests/fuzz/builtins/fixed/corpus/fixed
            [der]=tests/fuzz/builtins/asn1/corpus/der
            [der_schema]=tests/fuzz/builtins/asn1/corpus/der_schema
            [codec]=tests/fuzz/builtins/emv/corpus/codec
            [query_parse]=tests/fuzz/query/corpus/parse
            [query_match]=tests/fuzz/query/corpus/match
            [query_program]=tests/fuzz/query/corpus/program
            [query_image]=tests/fuzz/query/corpus/image
            [query_pairs]=tests/fuzz/query/corpus/match
          )
          for target in read visitor fixed der der_schema roundtrip utf8 codec query_parse query_match query_program query_image query_pairs; do
            mkdir -p "build/fuzz/findings/$target" "build/fuzz/corpus/$target"
            dictionary=()
            if [[ "$target" == query_program ]]; then
              dictionary=(-dict=tests/fuzz/query/query.dict)
            fi
            "build/fuzz/tests/fuzz/fuzz_$target" \
              "build/fuzz/corpus/$target" "${corpus_dir[$target]}" \
              "${dictionary[@]}" \
              -max_total_time=60 -max_len=4096 -timeout=10 -rss_limit_mb=2048 \
              -artifact_prefix="build/fuzz/findings/$target/" \
              2>&1 | tee "build/fuzz/findings/$target/run.log" || status=1
          done
          exit "$status"
      - name: Save reproducing inputs and logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: c-fuzz-findings-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/fuzz/findings/
          if-no-files-found: warn

property.yml.definition:
name: Deterministic Property Tests

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  property:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        configuration: [default, minimal]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Configure property suite
        shell: bash
        run: |
          options=()
          if [[ '${{ matrix.configuration }}' == minimal ]]; then
            options=(-DOPENTLV_FORMAT_ASN1=OFF -DOPENTLV_EMV=OFF
                     -DOPENTLV_BLUETOOTH=OFF -DOPENTLV_NFC=OFF
                     -DOPENTLV_DHCP=OFF -DOPENTLV_LLDP=OFF -DOPENTLV_DOCUMENT=OFF)
          fi
          cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=11 -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF \
            -DOPENTLV_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON \
            -DOPENTLV_BUILD_UNIT_TESTS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_INTEGRATION_TESTS=OFF \
            -DOPENTLV_BUILD_PROPERTY_TESTS=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=OFF \
            -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DOPENTLV_PROPERTY_COUNT=1000 \
            -DOPENTLV_PROPERTY_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "${options[@]}"
      - name: Build generator and property verifier
        run: cmake --build build --target property-generate property-roundtrip test-query-conformance --parallel 2
      - name: Generate and verify complete cases
        run: ctest --test-dir build -L property --output-on-failure --no-tests=error --parallel 2
      - name: Preserve failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: property-failures-${{ matrix.configuration }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            build/property-failures/
            build/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Discard successful corpus
        if: success()
        run: rm -rf build/property-data

query-hardening.yml.definition:
name: Query hardening
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  contracts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 ninja-build
      - name: Configure full C and C++ contracts
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-18 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-18
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DOPENTLV_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=11 -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_PROPERTY_TESTS=OFF
          -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer'
          -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer'
          -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined'
      - name: Audit transitive internal dependencies and recursion
        run: |
          python3 scripts/test_query_contracts.py
          python3 scripts/test_query_release.py
          python3 tests/query/test_minimize.py
          python3 tests/query/test_adversarial_campaign.py
          python3 tests/query/generate_adversarial_plans.py --check
          python3 scripts/check_query_contracts.py --clang clang-18 --generated build/generated/include --output build/query-contracts.json
          python3 scripts/check_query_release.py --output build/query-release.json
      - run: cmake --build build --parallel 2
      - name: Audit production archive symbols and emitted call dependencies
        run: python3 scripts/check_query_objects.py --archive build/tlv/libtlv.a --output build/query-object-contracts.json
      - name: Sanitized Core suites, conformance and corruption regressions
        env:
          ASAN_OPTIONS: detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1
          UBSAN_OPTIONS: halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
        run: |
          ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure --no-tests=error --parallel 2
          python3 tests/query/adversarial_campaign.py --native build/tests/query/test-query-adversarial --equivalence build/tests/query/test-query-equivalence --commit '${{ github.sha }}' --output build/query-adversarial
          python3 tests/query/run.py --native build/tests/query/test-query-conformance --commit '${{ github.sha }}' --property-cases 32 --evidence build/query-evidence
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: query-hardening-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            build/query-contracts.json
            build/query-object-contracts.json
            build/query-release.json
            build/query-evidence/
            build/query-adversarial/
            build/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log
  boundaries32:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 g++-multilib ninja-build
      - name: Configure native x86 resource and ABI contracts
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-18 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-18
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-m32 -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-m32
          -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=-m32 -DOPENTLV_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=11 -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_INTEGRATION_TESTS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
      - run: cmake --build build --target test-unit-tlv test-unit-tlvpp test-query-conformance test-query-cxx-conformance test-query-abi test-query-plan test-query-constexpr test-query-adversarial test-query-equivalence --parallel 2
      - name: Run exact and one-short capacities, operation budgets and x86 corpus
        run: |
          ctest --test-dir build -R 'Query|query' --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
          python3 tests/query/check_abi.py --native build/tests/query/test-query-abi --output build/query-abi32.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: query-boundaries-x86-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            build/query-abi32.json
            build/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log
  memory:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 ninja-build
      - name: Build the complete C core with MemorySanitizer
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build/msan -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-18 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-18 \
            -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins=2 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fPIE' \
            -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS='-fsanitize=memory -pie' \
            -DOPENTLV_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=OFF \
            -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
          cmake --build build/msan --target tlv --parallel 2
      - name: Compile and run the persistent shared Query corpus
        env:
          MSAN_OPTIONS: halt_on_error=1:exit_code=86
        run: |
          python3 tests/query/memory_driver.py --output build/query-memory-driver.c
          clang-18 -std=c99 -DTLV_STATIC_DEFINE -I tlv/include -I build/msan/generated/include \
            -fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins=2 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fPIE -pie \
            build/query-memory-driver.c build/msan/tlv/libtlv.a -lm -o build/query-memory-driver
          python3 tests/query/memory_campaign.py --native build/query-memory-driver --output build/query-memory-evidence
          clang-18 -std=c99 -DTLV_STATIC_DEFINE -I tlv/include -I build/msan/generated/include \
            -fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins=2 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fPIE -pie \
            tests/query/adversarial.c build/msan/tlv/libtlv.a -lm -o build/query-adversarial-msan
          python3 tests/query/adversarial_campaign.py --native build/query-adversarial-msan --msan --output build/query-adversarial-msan-evidence
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: query-memory-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            build/query-memory-driver.c
            build/query-memory-evidence/
            build/query-adversarial-msan-evidence/

  static-plans:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        frontend: ['ON', 'OFF']
        sets: ['ON', 'OFF']
        cxx: ['ON', 'OFF']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 ninja-build
      - name: Configure C-only plans
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-18 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-18
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=11 -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD=99 -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_CXX=${{ matrix.cxx }} -DOPENTLV_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_UNIT_TESTS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_INTEGRATION_TESTS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_DOCUMENT=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_QUERY_FRONTEND=${{ matrix.frontend }}
          -DOPENTLV_QUERY_SET_OPERATIONS=${{ matrix.sets }}
          -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer'
          -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer'
          -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined'
      - run: cmake --build build --target test-query-plan test-query-adversarial --parallel 2
      - if: matrix.cxx == 'ON'
        run: cmake --build build --target test-query-constexpr test-query-equivalence --parallel 2
      - run: ctest --test-dir build -R '^query-((static|constexpr)-plan|adversarial.*)$' --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
      - name: Verify absence of runtime frontend symbols
        if: matrix.frontend == 'OFF'
        run: |
          nm --defined-only build/tlv/libtlv.a > build/symbols.txt
          if grep -E ' (tlv_query_compile[^ ]*|tlv_query_parse[^ ]*|tlv_query_program_load[^ ]*|lex|parse)$' build/symbols.txt; then
            echo 'Unexpected Query frontend symbol in executor-only archive'
            exit 1
          fi

static-analysis.yml.definition:
name: Static Analysis

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# PR and Full runs require pre-commit, cppcheck and clang-tidy.
concurrency:
  group: static-analysis-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  pre-commit:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: pre-commit checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      # Runs the same hooks, at the same pinned versions, as
      # .pre-commit-config.yaml: clang-format plus the whitespace/YAML/
      # markdownlint checks. Keeping one source of truth for hook versions
      # here avoids CI silently drifting out of sync with what contributors
      # run locally.
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Check the public C++ consumer boundary
        run: |
          python scripts/test_cxx_boundary.py
          python scripts/check_cxx_boundary.py
      - name: Check result and diagnostic invariants
        run: |
          python scripts/test_diagnostic_returns.py
          python scripts/check_diagnostic_returns.py
          python scripts/generate_diagnostic_vocabulary.py --check
          python -B scripts/test_diagnostic_vocabulary.py
      - name: Test CI and release contracts
        run: |
          python -B scripts/test_core_release.py
          python -B scripts/test_package.py
          python -B scripts/test_license_headers.py
          python -B scripts/test_core_performance.py
          python -B scripts/test_ci_workflows.py
      - uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1

  cppcheck:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: cppcheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # ubuntu-24.04's apt package (2.13.0) predates this pin; built from
    # source since upstream only publishes a Windows installer, not a Linux
    # binary, for releases (github.com/cppcheck-opensource/cppcheck).
    env:
      CPPCHECK_VERSION: '2.21.0'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install Ninja
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ninja-build

      - name: Cache cppcheck ${{ env.CPPCHECK_VERSION }} build
        id: cppcheck-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cppcheck-install
          key: cppcheck-${{ env.CPPCHECK_VERSION }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}

      - name: Build cppcheck ${{ env.CPPCHECK_VERSION }}
        if: steps.cppcheck-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          git clone --branch "$CPPCHECK_VERSION" --depth 1 \
            https://github.com/cppcheck-opensource/cppcheck.git "$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck-src"
          cmake -S "$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck-src" -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck-build" -G Ninja \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck-install"
          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck-build" --parallel
          cmake --install "$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck-build"

      - name: Add cppcheck to PATH
        run: echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck-install/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
          -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD=99 -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF

      - name: Run cppcheck
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cmake --build build --target cppcheck 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck.log"

      - name: Summarize cppcheck findings
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 scripts/summarize_static_analysis.py cppcheck "$RUNNER_TEMP/cppcheck.log"

  clang-tidy:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    name: clang-tidy
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      CC: clang-18
      CXX: clang++-18
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install Clang and Ninja
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-18 clang-tidy-18 ninja-build

      # Only configures the project (compile_commands.json is written at
      # generate time); this never needs a full build, matching the cppcheck
      # job above. C++23 matches the standard build-clang.yml tests with, so
      # tlv++'s compat.hpp polyfills are exercised the same way in both.
      - name: Configure CMake
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
          -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
          -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD=99 -DCMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=23 -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_INTEGRATION_TESTS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_QUERY_TESTS=OFF -DOPENTLV_BUILD_PROPERTY_TESTS=OFF

      - name: Run clang-tidy
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cmake --build build --target clang-tidy 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/clang-tidy.log"

      - name: Summarize clang-tidy findings
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 scripts/summarize_static_analysis.py clang-tidy "$RUNNER_TEMP/clang-tidy.log"

  gate:
    name: Static analysis gate
    if: always()
    needs: [pre-commit, cppcheck, clang-tidy]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Require every static check
        env:
          CHECK_RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py static-gate

valgrind.yml.definition:
name: Valgrind Memcheck

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Private candidate tag supplied only by the release orchestrator
        type: string
        default: ''
      full:
        type: boolean
        default: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full:
        description: Run the complete configuration matrix
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  memcheck:
    name: Memcheck (full)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      MEMCHECK_EXCLUDE_LABELS: no-memcheck
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply proposed release version locally
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: python -B scripts/core_release.py prepare

      - name: Install tools
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y gcc g++ cmake ninja-build valgrind python3
      - name: Configure plain GCC Debug build
        run: >-
          cmake -S . -B build/valgrind -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
          -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=11 -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_MEMCHECK=ON -DOPENTLV_BUILD_TESTS=ON
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_PROPERTY_TESTS=OFF
          -DOPENTLV_BUILD_FUZZING=OFF
      - name: Build C and C++ suites
        run: cmake --build build/valgrind --parallel 4
      - name: Run tests and launcher regressions without instrumentation
        run: ctest --test-dir build/valgrind --output-on-failure --no-tests=error --parallel 4
      - name: Run Memcheck
        run: ctest --test-dir build/valgrind -T memcheck -LE "$MEMCHECK_EXCLUDE_LABELS" --output-on-failure --no-tests=error --parallel 4
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: valgrind-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/valgrind/Testing/
          if-no-files-found: warn
